2608.07302.title: Same Attention, Different Truths: Put Logit-Lens over Visual Attention to Detect and Mitigate LVLM Object Hallucination
2608.07302.paper_summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) often suffer from object hallucination, generating objects that are absent from the image. Prior work largely attributes this to insufficient visual attention. However, we find that both real and hallucinated objects receive equally strong visual attention in the model's mid-to-late layers, suggesting that the key issue may not be how much the model attends, but what it attends to and why. To this end, we decode the visual features of high-attention regions using Logit Lens, and observe that regions corresponding to real objects can be correctly decoded to the target object tokens, whereas those for hallucinated objects cannot. Building on this, we identify two hallucination mechanisms: (i) visual uncertainty, triggered by semantically similar or confusable regions; masking these regions eliminates the hallucination. (ii) contextual prior, triggered by strong co-occurrence priors; even when the initially attended region is masked, the hallucination persists and attention drifts to other regions. Based on these findings, we propose a simple yet effective training-free Detect-Mitigate framework comprising a Logit-Lens Consistency Check to detect hallucination and targeted remedies: High-Attention Regions Masking (HARM) for visual uncertainty hallucination, and Visual Evidence Enhanced Decoding (VEED) for contextual prior hallucination. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple hallucination benchmarks. Code will be available.
2608.07302.paper_summary_zh: 大型視覺-語言模型（LVLMs）經常遭遇物體幻覺，生成圖像中不存在的物體。先前的研究主要將此歸因於視覺注意力不足。然而，我們發現模型的中後層對真實物體和幻覺物體的視覺注意力同樣強烈，這表明關鍵問題可能不在於模型的注意力程度，而在於它注意的是什麼以及為什麼。為此，我們使用 Logit Lens 解碼高注意力區域的視覺特徵，並觀察到對應於真實物體的區域可以正確解碼為目標物體標記，而幻覺物體的區域則無法。基於此，我們識別出兩種幻覺機制：（i）視覺不確定性，由語義相似或易混淆的區域觸發；遮蔽這些區域可以消除幻覺。（ii）上下文先驗，由強烈的共現先驗觸發；即使最初注意的區域被遮蔽，幻覺仍然持續，注意力會漂移到其他區域。根據這些發現，我們提出了一個簡單而有效的無需訓練的檢測-緩解框架，包括 Logit-Lens 一致性檢查以檢測幻覺和針對性補救：高注意力區域遮蔽（HARM）用於視覺不確定性幻覺，以及視覺證據增強解碼（VEED）用於上下文先驗幻覺。我們的方法在多個幻覺基準上達到了最先進的結果。代碼將會提供。
